digest.component_or_area: Coordinator for non-create operations (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling)
propositions: Non-create plans must execute atomic postconditions in dependency order; partial failures preserve earlier successes and re-observe only remaining drift within shared budget.

Endpoint-failure fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across ≥2 tickets on the same endpoint; provider fuse additionally requires ≥2 distinct endpoints of the same provider.

Eligible fuse-counter outcomes are exhausted_transient and retryable_deferred (budget-capped only); excluded are commit_unknown, recovered, permanent_failure, ticket-local 404, skipped, and S2 defer reasons.
commit_unknown outcomes are ticket-scoped (never stop siblings), projected to deferred bucket (not applied/failed), and replay-forbidden for next pass.
Matching success resets fuse consecutive counter to zero; remaining plans defer with reason/scope/retry_not_before when fuse opens; independent scopes continue executing.
Per-pass in-memory counters (no cross-pass durability); physical attempts, warnings, permanent failures, and opaque diagnostics never increment fuse counters.
